name: interferon regulatory factor 2 binding protein 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: IRF2BP2 encodes interferon regulatory factor 2-binding protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
